notes: Matching per prompt_align.md (strict). Generated map: outputs/direct_law_sonnet_r1.json (nodes and edges only; evidence ignored), built from the Act 938/2014 alone. Kela caseworker and Kela system (reference caseworker/system_automatic vs generated kela_caseworker/kela_system) are treated as the same actor; every match where they differ carries match_type_note starting 'actor differs:'. Citizen, landlord, third-party and authority nodes are not matched to the Kela side of the same exchange. A reference actor 'unclear' matches any actor. match_type: exact = a node is the same unit of work (it may carry minor extra detail); partial = covered only in part, or split across several nodes; merged = covered by a node that also covers another reference step. Generic 'send written decision' nodes are matched to G63, except where the guideline has a dedicated step for that decision (landlord payment G77, recovery G109). The generated map models the version of the Act without student housing-supplement rules and has no asset test, so G23, G57, G89 etc. have no counterpart. order_checks: (predecessor, step) pairs from the reference predecessor lists where both are matched, in reference order (cap 60). Pairs whose matched node sets share a node are skipped (listed in summary). forward_len/reverse_len are the shortest directed path lengths between the two matched node sets over all generated edges (loops included); same_order is true only if a forward path exists and is no longer than the reverse path, false if the reverse is shorter or the only path, not_connected if neither exists. generated_pair is the node pair realising the deciding path.
